purpose: Expand source coverage around initial 13D events while preserving 13D as the first implementation and review priority.
runtime_integration: Planning registry consumed by the explanatory report builder; not a collector configuration or scheduler.

rules: Separate filing facts, normalized facts, interpretations and external enrichment.
No automatic aggregation of overlapping reporting-person holdings.
Do not equate an accession, an issuer, a reporting group and a campaign.
Initial-event features use only verified publicly available information at the decision cutoff.
Later filings are follow-up evidence, not retroactive initial-event features.
Preserve current human-first review cases and immutable v1 protocols.
Unknown reporting basis, identity or evidence remains unresolved; do not infer from filer reputation.

stages.label: 13D first: ownership, purpose and specific action
stages.implementation_status: Collection and candidate parsing exist; refined extraction and semantic validation remain development work.
stages.execution_status: first_to_act; no job launched by this plan
stages.scope: Initial 13D is the primary event; relevant exhibits complete evidence; amendments form separately timed updates.
stages.next_action: Draft the refined field definitions and review layout; then continue human-first 13D development review before model assessment.
stages.gate: Versioned extraction definitions, source/citation checks and independently evaluated field-level reliability before bulk semantic classification.

stages.label: 13G: linked ownership history and comparison context
stages.implementation_status: Queued; no dedicated discovery, collector or parser added yet.
stages.scope: Start with earlier reports for the same reporting parties and security as reviewed 13D events; a broader comparison universe is a separately specified extension.
fields: reporting basis: qualified institution, passive or exempt, where evidenced
shares, class percentage and ownership date
stages.next_action: Design bounded linked-history discovery and a small parser pilot after the core 13D field contract stabilizes.
stages.gate: Validate historical identity links, reporting-basis interpretation and as-of/publication dates. Do not label all 13G passive or every transition activist.

stages.label: Proxy materials and 8-K: demands, responses and developments
stages.implementation_status: Queued targeted retrieval and extraction; form list is a starting scope, not a complete proxy taxonomy.
stages.scope: Relevant documents for existing 13D situations, including referenced agreements; avoid an unrestricted proxy/8-K crawl.
stages.next_action: Define relevance and retrieval bounds, source-specific evidence rules and distinct initial-context versus follow-up tables.
stages.gate: Verify relevance, party attribution and public availability; distinguish allegations, proposals, agreements and completed actions.

stages.label: 13F: manager portfolio context
stages.implementation_status: Queued enrichment; not required for the first 13D review or baseline.
stages.scope: Matched managers and the reports public by each event cutoff; detect amendments, shared discretion and reporting limitations.
fields: reported shares and value with schema-specific units
concentration within the reported holdings subset
stages.next_action: Specify manager crosswalk, amendment handling and a reported-portfolio denominator before deriving concentration.
stages.gate: Do not treat quarter-end holdings as known before filing, infer precise trade dates, or describe 13F as total AUM/net exposure.

stages.label: Forms 3/4/5: insider roles and transactions
stages.implementation_status: Queued enrichment; not required for the first 13D review or baseline.
stages.scope: Relevant reporting people and issuers, with separate direct/indirect and derivative records.
stages.next_action: Design code/footnote extraction and identity matching after higher-priority filing work.
stages.gate: Distinguish purchases, sales, grants, exercises and other transfers; do not infer conviction from all acquisitions.

operational_limits: This update records scope and sequence; it does not launch collection, schedulers or model calls.
Existing 13D collector, frozen manifests and raw files remain unchanged.
Retain existing resource guards; estimate volume/storage and set bounded manifests before new collection.
The 52-candidate human-first draft remains unclassified by models; its workbook is still pending.
No expansion stage is a silent prerequisite for the first 13D baseline.
